newsitem.title: USA: Enron to restore 200 mmcfd gas to USG line.
newsitem.headline: Enron to restore 200 mmcfd gas to USG line.

text.p: Enron Corp said Monday that a U.S. Gulf natural gas line, shut January 27 for "unplanned maintenance", will be back in operation Tuesday morning.

"The MOPS (Matagorda Offshore Pipeline System) line went down for unplanned maintenance on January 27. It should be back tomorrow morning at 1000 CST," a company spokeswoman said, adding the work has curtailed about 200 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) of natural gas flow.
The line, which runs from Mustang Island Block 831 offshore Texas to Tivoli, Texas, and operated by its Houston Pipe Line unit, normally flows about 400 mmcfd.
The curtailment affected flows south of platform 686.
